Name: Em's Horses
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
Eighteen (18) retexture options for the horse. Optional saddle and/or bridle
Available for Content Patcher and compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7911]Horse Overhaul[/url]

The different types are:
Gypsy, DappleGrey, Donkey, BlueRoan, Appaloosa, Unicorn, Mule, Zebra, RedRoan
Paint, Haflinger, Fjord, BelgianDraft, Shire, Chestnut, Bay, Mustang, Krobus

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]﻿

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Horses CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

The default is the Chestnut horse. To choose a different type:
Open ﻿the [i]config.json[/i] file in the horse mod folder
Replace "[color=#e69138]Chestnut[/color]" with the name of the type you like
There is a [i]reference.png[/i] with all the options in the folder

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/bv0Xx51t/Saddle1.png[/img]

Additionally, you can choose if you want to tack up your horse
Replace "[color=#e69138]false[/color]" with "[color=#e69138]true[/color]" to dis/enable the saddle and/or bridle
Save and close the folder again, and you're all set!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/5ySh95dL/AT.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Horses AT"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Buy the paint tools from Robin at the Carpenter's shop
With the scissors selected, left-click the horse and choose its type
You can pick each horse with or without a saddle and bridle

Note: if you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7911]Horse Overhaul[/url], change the left-click key first. Horse Overhaul uses left-click to open the saddlebag. AT uses it to access the texture menu. If you change the opening of the saddlebags to another key, you can access the texture menu with the scissors.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MGb2cDyd/Patchnotes.png[/img]

[i]Update 1.1 Resolved missing red roan in config options and gypsy grammar mistake in reference image

Note: Like my dogs, because my horse design is a bit taller than the vanilla horse, the hats sit slightly too low
To solve this, you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22631]Hats On Pets Plus[/url]. This allows you to adjust the placement of the hat on custom animal sprites. Or if you have a specific hat you really want them to wear, let me know, and I will add it to a custom script for you[/i]

Downloads.Description: Horses for Alternative Textures. Both with and without tack.
